name: realistic-fusion-refreshed-core
title: Realistic Fusion Refreshed Core
author: Truls Johnsen
description:
Shared library for Realistic Fusion Refreshed. Owns every fluid and item prototype, and the extraction chain that turns water into deuterium and lithium. Realistic Fusion Refreshed adds the reactors that consume them.

Before you install, two things this mod will not do. Saves from Realistic Fusion Power or Durikkan's 2.0 port are NOT supported: this mod shares no prototype names with either, so nothing carries over and no migration is provided. Neither can be enabled beside this one: Durikkan's port declares Factorio 2.0 and the original 1.1, and this mod needs 2.1. And the buildings here are NOT balanced for quality. The mod loads and runs under Space Age with quality enabled, verified against Factorio 2.0.77, and that is the whole of the claim: nothing in it is tuned against quality.

Credit for the original design goes to Romner_set, for the 2.0 port to Durikkan, and for graphics work to PreLeyZero; none of their licences asks for it. The graphics shipped here are Krastorio 2's, under LGPLv3 -- see legal-note.txt beside this file.
